text: ラブラブカップルの　＊が　しょうぶを　しかけてきた！

structure.jp: ラブラブカップルの　＊が

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: てくる after a verb says the action comes toward you. しかけてきた = 'came at you and started (a battle)'.

patterns.name: 〜の (same person)
patterns.explanation: の between a label and a name says both are the same people: the label tells what kind of people the names are. ラブラブカップルの　＊ = '＊ the lovey-dovey couple'.
